newsitem.title: UK: First Technology trading currently ahead.
newsitem.headline: First Technology trading currently ahead.

text.p: First Technology Plc chairman Fred Westlake said the current year had begun well and trading was ahead of the previous year.
"Trading levels across the group (are) running significantly above those for the corresponding period of last year," he said in a statement to the annual meeting.
He said established products continued to claim new customers and markets while newer products were starting to make "useful contributions."
"Your board continues to take a very confident view of the group's future," Westlake added.
First Technology makes computer generated models of crash dummies and other car safety equipment.
Westlake said General Motors had specified the company's crash dummies for use in a new study.

General Motors also has agreed to take fuel level sensing units from First Technology, whose Grand Blanc plant in the U.S. is expected to produce over two million units this year, rising to over four million units by the end of 1997.
By 1000 GMT it's share price was marked up 23p at 612-1/2p.
